analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive day. RSI has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone, while the MACD histogram has halted its improvement and shifted towards worsening. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.40 times the 5-day average, indicating a lack of directional conviction. The price is trading between the support at 85,300 and resistance at 89,580, with no clear trend reversal signals identified.
